summary_en: MBK Co., Ltd. reports progress on its share buyback program authorized in December 2025. As of October 31, 2026, the company has acquired 3,514,700 shares for 785,928,000 yen against an authorization ceiling of 4,100,000 shares (13.37% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) and 820,000,000 yen. The buyback period runs through December 11, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Progress on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
MBK Co., Ltd. announced progress on its share buyback program on November 2, 2026. The company is executing a buyback authorized by board resolutions dated December 12, 2025, and May 18, 2026. The authorization permits acquisition of up to 4,100,000 ordinary shares, representing 13.37% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total purchase price of 820 million yen. The buyback period extends from January 30, 2026, through December 11, 2026, and acquisitions are made through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

As of October 31, 2026, cumulative acquisitions under this authorization totaled 3,514,700 shares for 785,928,000 yen. This represents consumption of approximately 85.7% of the share authorization and approximately 95.8% of the yen authorization. In October 2026 alone, the company acquired zero shares. As of the same date, the company held 2,058,325 shares in treasury stock against a total of 32,806,190 ordinary shares outstanding.
